worker_judgment_notes: Uses the official DataKC/KCPD 2024 Socrata endpoint with exact NIBRS/IBRS code rules. The 2024 endpoint is involvement-level, so the selected id_field is a Socrata-projected report_no|ibrs|offense key to collapse duplicate people on the same report/offense; raw rows should not be interpreted as totals. Rape maps only penetration-category NIBRS sex offenses 11A/11B/11C, excluding fondling and statutory rape. Bounds are the KCMO municipal block-group envelope from the repo crosswalk; the runner's spatial join remains authoritative.
